connector.name: Backtest360
connector.registryDescription: MCP server exposing the Backtest360 engine API as tools for AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.backtest360.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package backtest360-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.backtest360. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Backtest360 engine API key, sent to the hosted MCP server as X-API-Key. Get a free key at https://backtest360.com/api-access.

env.name: BACKTEST360_API_KEY
env.description: Backtest360 engine API key, sent to the engine as X-API-Key. Get a free key at https://backtest360.com/api-access.
